install: if [[ -n "${SCRIPT_DOWNLOAD_ROOT_URL:-}" ]]; then CURL_AUTH=""; [[ -n "${GITHUB_SCRIPTS_TOKEN:-}" ]] && CURL_AUTH="Authorization: token $GITHUB_SCRIPTS_TOKEN"; echo "[Setup] Downloading from: $SCRIPT_DOWNLOAD_ROOT_URL/setup.sh" && _setup_script=$(curl -fsSL ${CURL_AUTH:+-H "$CURL_AUTH"} "$SCRIPT_DOWNLOAD_ROOT_URL/setup.sh") && source /dev/stdin <<< "$_setup_script" || echo "[Setup] Warning: GPG setup failed, continuing without commit signing"; else echo "[Setup] SCRIPT_DOWNLOAD_ROOT_URL not set — skipping GPG signing setup"; fi; source .cursor/scripts/install.sh
